Owaisi objects to Vande Mataram bill, citing religious belief

AIMIM leader Asaduddin Owaisi stated he is a Muslim and does not worship anyone but Allah, in reaction to a bill related to Vande Mataram. The bill was passed, prompting Owaisi's response. He asserted his religious identity and refusal to worship any entity other than God.
